⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

From #1 bestseller and USA Today bestseller Morgan Rice, whose books have over 10,000 five-star ratings, comes the debut of a thrilling new romantasy series, RIVER CROW, ideal for fans of Callie Hart, Carissa Broadbent, and Ali Hazelwood.

An ancient vampire stumbles through time, into modern day New York City, lost in a world he can't understand.

River Crow runs into him and can’t escape her attraction.

Her curiosity stronger than her caution, she offers him her spare room and more questions than he knows how to answer.

Soon, River is forced to confront the impossible: the strange, compelling man in her apartment is exactly who he says he is: and he didn't come through time alone.

Now she's caught between a world she thought she understood and one she never knew existed, standing beside a man who is dangerous, ancient, and — against every instinct she has — impossible to walk away from.

Slow-burn romance meets supernatural intrigue in a high-stakes collision of two worlds, where the boundaries of time dissolve and an ancient darkness learns to navigate the dazzling, disorienting light of the modern age. As strangers become reluctant allies, two people from opposite ends of history must decide how much they're willing to risk for someone they were never supposed to meet. The real question isn't whether Aldric and River can survive in each other’s world: it's whether either of them can survive what's growing between them.

Future books in the series are available!
